items.t: The Log Line That Writes Its Own SQL: rsyslog omclickhouse Injection (CVE-2026-93404)
items.e: CVE-2026-93404: SQL injection in rsyslog's omclickhouse built-in template. STDSQL escaping misses ClickHouse backslash escapes, letting attacker-controlled log content forge stored records or evaluate expressions with the ClickHouse account
